policy.period_evidence: Stored as printed (includes spacing variants such as 'JANUARY 31,2018').

policy.cargo_rounding: Stored as printed; COMBINED and component sums can differ by 1 ton.
policy.scanned_months: 2018-10 and 2022-06 use the printed same_month_prior_year column of the following year's report.
